bib.title: Think you have Solved Question Answering? Try ARC, the AI2 Reasoning Challenge

question: Can a question set of natural grade-school science questions, filtered to defeat retrieval and co-occurrence methods, drive research on questions needing reasoning?
hypothesis: Questions that simple retrieval and co-occurrence solvers fail will also defeat neural models from SQuAD and SNLI.
contributions: ARC question set (7787 questions) with Challenge and Easy partitions
Baseline results and implementations of three neural baselines (DecompAttn, BiDAF, DGEM)

method.summary: Collects 7787 non-diagram science multiple-choice questions, splits them by whether IR and PMI solvers both fail, releases a 14M-sentence corpus, and scores nine baselines on the test partitions.

datasets.name: ARC Challenge Set
datasets.source: US standardized science tests; Table 7 lists sources; Mercury partner data for non-commercial research
datasets.preprocessing: Non-diagram, multiple choice only; Challenge = wrong by both IR and PMI solvers

datasets.name: ARC Corpus
datasets.source: Web search from ~100 templates over 80 science topics, plus AristoMini
datasets.preprocessing: De-duplicated, stripped to text, chunked into sentences

datasets.name: SciTail (extended version)
datasets.preprocessing: Used to train DecompAttn and DGEM

datasets.name: SQuAD
datasets.preprocessing: BiDAF trained on it then tuned on science questions

datasets.name: Waterloo corpus
datasets.preprocessing: Used by IR and PMI solvers for the filter

models.name: IR solver
models.architecture: Elasticsearch retrieval score of top sentence for q+option

other.search: requires non-stopword overlap with q and with option

models.name: DGEM
models.architecture: decomposed graph entailment, proprietary parser + Open IE

other.init: trained on SQuAD, tuned on science questions

inference.samples: one run per baseline; no seeds stated
inference.retrieval: ElasticSearch over ARC Corpus; sentences must contain answer choice; drop sentences over 300 characters, with negation or noisy; top 8 sentences across answer choices

parameters.entailment score: max over premises per answer choice
parameters.BiDAF option choice: option with highest percentage of lemmatized non-stopword tokens covered by the answer span

metrics.name: score
metrics.definition: 1 point if correct, 1/k for a k-way tie containing the answer; sum divided by number of questions

eval.protocol: Test partitions of Challenge and Easy; 95% CI of +-2.5% on Challenge; no human baseline reported

95% corpus coverage and 75% relevance are informal sampled analyses.
Baselines are from 2018 and the leaderboard is the source for up-to-date results.
